description: This file defines span limits for OpenTelemetry tracing, including default constants and a SpanLimits struct with a constructor that initializes limits based on environment variables.

classes.name: SpanLimits
classes.description: Struct representing various limits for spans in OpenTelemetry tracing, such as attribute length, count, event count, link count, and per-attribute limits.

methods.name: NewSpanLimits
methods.description: Function that returns a SpanLimits instance with all limits set according to environment variables or default values.
